chunks: Can mislead anyone away from Him,

key_terms.فَاتِنِينَ: Misleaders or those who cause others to stray from the truth

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that believers are not 'fatineen' (misleaders) in Surah As-Saff?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the spiritual resilience of the faithful, particularly the Imams and the righteous community, against external influences. It highlights that true guidance is divinely secured, preventing believers from being swayed by temporary worldly temptations or deceptive arguments. This assurance reinforces the concept of 'Ismah (infallibility) for the Imams and the steadfastness of the general believers in maintaining their path.
